news.title: Nvidia chip buyers told to rule out Chinese renters to purchase GPUs, sources say

news.title: Latin America has the copper and energy the AI build-out needs. Infrastructure is the test
news.summary: Latin America’s copper, oil, gas and rare earths could benefit from rising AI energy demand, if infrastructure and fiscal policy attract investment.

news.title: Taking on Starlink: Europe’s largest satellite factory opens in push to rival Musk
news.summary: The 20,000-square-meter mega factory will be able to produce up to 500 satellites annually, making it the world's third-largest satellite production site.

news.title: Robots could be doing household chores in just 1-2 years, Chinese EV firm says
news.summary: Xpeng Co-President Brian Gu shared his humanoid robot predictions with CNBC in an interview Thursday.

news.summary: The AI boom could trigger a recession, but data centers remain an attractive investment opportunity, a hedge fund manager said.

news.title: Global stocks rally as investors shrug off U.S. tariffs and AI jitters to 'fish for bargains'
news.summary: Investors appeared to have shrugged off a fresh set of tariffs unveiled by the White House on Wednesday, targeting more than a dozen major trading partners.

news.title: SpaceX, Musk pledge to donate a share each to active Trump Accounts
news.summary: SpaceX said it will donate one share of the company's class A stock to every active Trump Account, and CEO Elon Musk would match it.

news.title: China’s Industrial Profits Jump at Fastest Pace in Five Months
news.summary: Earnings growth at China’s industrial enterprises hit a five-month high in October, as higher commodity costs and demand for artificial intelligence products continued to prop up prices.

news.title: Counterpoint on China's AI progress under chip curbs
news.summary: Wei Sun, Principal Analyst for AI at Counterpoint Research, discusses the outlook for Chinese internet giants and leading AI labs as updated US chip controls further restrict access to the advanced semiconductors needed to train frontier AI models. She speaks with Annabelle Droulers on Bloomberg: Tech Asia. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: China Hedge Fund Star Builds Operating System Kernel for AI
news.summary: An artificial intelligence startup founded by one of China’s most successful hedge fund managers is preparing to release its first product – the core of an operating system designed for AI agents rather than humans.

news.title: Holidays to Test AI Shopping Bots From Google, Amazon, Meta and OpenAI
news.summary: Google, Amazon, Meta and OpenAI all want to help pick your holiday gifts. Whose advice will shoppers take?

news.title: Musk Says He’ll Give US Children Another SpaceX Share Every Year
news.summary: Elon Musk and SpaceX will give every child in the US another share in the space exploration company every year, according to a post on X from the world’s richest man.

news.title: TDK Bets on AI Data Centers and Robots to Fuel Sensor Growth
news.summary: TDK Corp. is preparing to boost production of its high-end magnetic sensors, seeking to capitalize on widening use of the components in cars, humanoid robots and AI data centers.

news.title: Netherlands to Fight Rollout of Proposed US Curbs on ASML
news.summary: The Dutch government said it will resist US plans to further restrict ASML Holding NV’s sales to China, calling the proposed rules a threat to Europe’s most valuable company and widening a rift with Washington.

news.title: SAP Weighs Cutting at Least 10,000 Positions in AI Restructuring
news.summary: SAP SE is preparing a plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to transform its software business for the artificial intelligence era, according to people familiar with the matter.

news.title: FIFA Says Hackers Accessed Personal Data in Cyberattack
news.summary: FIFA was targeted by a cyberattack that resulted in hackers accessing “personal and business information,” the football governing body said in a statement on Thursday.

news.title: QRT to Merge $2 Billion Hedge Fund With Flagship Qube Strategy
news.summary: Qube Research & Technologies, one of the fastest growing investment firms in the world, is set to merge its crypto-focused money pool with its flagship hedge fund strategy.

news.title: Africa’s Intra-Continental Trade Hit $213.8 Billion But Faces Payment Barriers
news.summary: The value of trade between African nations rose about 6% last year to $213.8 billion, but accounted for only 14.6% of the continent’s total trade due to regional economic integration challenges, according to a study.

news.title: StanChart’s Crypto Custody Unit Suffers Data Breach
news.summary: Standard Chartered’s crypto custody subsidiary Zodia Custody Ltd. said it had suffered a security breach, exposing some client and staff information.

news.title: Marc Levinson on How UPS Created Modern Logistics
news.summary: UPS was founded nearly a century ago in the basement of a Seattle saloon by James E. Casey and his business partner Claude Ryan. Marc Levinson has just written a biography of Casey and the company he founded...

news.title: AI Trade Rebounds in Late Buying Ahead of US Holiday

news.title: Banks Risk Outages as They Contend With AI Threats
news.summary: The risk of cyberattacks is forcing banks to contend with a growing number of technical hiccups as they race to adapt aging infrastructure and find vulnerabilities before they’re exploited. news.title: Is Alice Huang a spy or not?
